verdict.gold_reason: Article 26(5) of Regulation 2015/1222 requires each coordinated capacity calculator to report every three months all reductions made during TSO validation under paragraph 3 to all regulatory authorities of the capacity calculation region. The report must include the location and amount of each reduction and the reasons for it.

other_articles.why: Article 16(3) requires regional coordination centres to report every three months to regulators and ACER on capacity reductions or deviations from coordinated actions. This is a different context: it concerns reductions made as a last resort to reach the linear trajectory or minimum capacity, not reductions made during TSO validation.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question's wording (bodies computing limits, trimming, operators double-checking) clearly maps to Article 26(5). Article 16(3) of Regulation 2019/943 is a similar quarterly report by regional coordination centres, so it is a possible confusion.
